prompts.name: pikeman
prompts.prompt: Create one production animation sprite sheet. Match reference's flat storybook ink and watercolor style: dark warm brown outlines, muted color blocks, only two shadow tones, subtle paper texture. NO 3D or clay. cute blue-and-gold Castle pikeman, steel closed helmet with blue plume, blue tunic, brown boots, long spear. EXACTLY 3 columns by 3 rows, nine separate poses in equal square cells, transparent background. All characters face RIGHT, identical costume anatomy proportions and scale across frames. Each cell fixed body center and ground baseline at 88% height, feet fully visible, generous margin, weapons fully inside cell; no overlap into neighboring cells. Row1: idle standing; walking left foot forward; walking passing pose. Row2: walking right foot forward; walking second passing pose; spear windup. Row3: forward spear thrust; recovery after attack; recoiling from hit. For mounted character walking means horse gait and rider stays mounted. No labels, no numbers, no grid lines, no base, no ground shadow, no scenery. Square canvas.
